narratives.body: NBC Sports reports that Darius Acuff Jr. made a brutal debut against the LA Clippers. NBC Sports also notes that Keegan Murray struggled significantly in the same game.
narratives.headline: Clippers: Acuff debut and Murray struggles

narratives.body: Yahoo Sports and KTLA report on how LA Clippers fans can obtain free parking and new jerseys for the opening night of the new season.
narratives.headline: Clippers: fan perks for opening night
